fishing: WHEN: Fri Oct 30 NE/E winds 10-15 kt lingering; focus sheltered Lemon Bay, passes, and protected flats early. PASSES-BEACH: redfish and flounder near Stump Pass / Englewood on live shrimp or gold spoons; pompano in the surf as temps cool; some snook/whiting off beach. LEMON BAY: strong redfish, snook, trout, sheepshead around docks, mangroves, oyster bars, flats; mangrove snapper at piers. NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper / cobia in 40-50 ft when wind allows; Spanish mackerel closer; offshore limited. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless gold spoons, popping cork. Sources: Waterline / Fishin Franks / Capt. Roger (Oct 27), FL Sportsman SW.
redtide: FWC Oct 30: K. brevis not observed in Southwest Florida past week. Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay and Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD (20 CFU/100mL on 10/26, DOH Sarasota Healthy Beaches). Englewood Beach GOOD ~10 CFU/100mL. No advisories for Englewood Beach / Manasota Key / Palm Island / Boca Grande.
fpl: Charlotte ~2, Sarasota ~149 outages (minor/isolated per trackers); small only, no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
